batches.brief:
Batch w1-b01 (pipeline analytics, wave 1 of 2). Convert three independent leaf units, one Lakeflow Job each in bundle ow_tp_analytics (PAUSED schedules, retries):
- analytics_daily: etl/scripts/analytics_daily.py — SQS otterworks-analytics + DynamoDB otterworks-analytics-events -> ow_tp.ow_tp_analytics.analytics_daily_summary + analytics_daily_outputs + reports_analytics_daily; job ow_tp_analytics_daily. Preserve eventType normalization, resolved_user_id mapping, hour buckets, ON CONFLICT (report_date) upsert semantics.
- audit_archive_weekly: etl/scripts/audit_archive_weekly.py — DynamoDB otterworks-audit-events >90d -> audit_events_archive + audit_events + reports_audit_archive; job ow_tp_analytics_audit_archive. LEGACY WRITE (batch delete of archived items) is inert until a committed legacy_write_authorized entry; target-side prune only.
- search_reindex_weekly: etl/scripts/search_reindex_weekly.py — document/file service HTTP APIs -> search_documents_index + search_files_index Delta surfaces; job ow_tp_analytics_search_reindex. Never touches the legacy MeiliSearch instance; keep the numberOfDocuments assert as a job gate.
Snapshot posture: materialize each unit's legacy source extract to ow_tp.ow_tp_analytics_src first (fixture via AWS_ENDPOINT_URL for AWS stores), then recon src vs target per tol-20261027-v1. Read .migration/units/<unit>/{dependencies.json,mapping_spec.json} and .migration/capabilities.json; evidence .migration/recon/wave-analytics-01/<batch>/.

Batch w1-b02 (pipeline analytics, wave 1 of 2). Convert two independent leaf units:
- storage_cleanup_daily: etl/scripts/storage_cleanup_daily.py — S3 otterworks-file-storage/files + DynamoDB otterworks-file-metadata -> file_storage_inventory + quarantined_files + reports_storage_cleanup; job ow_tp_analytics_storage_cleanup. LEGACY WRITE (delete of quarantined source objects) is inert until a committed legacy_write_authorized entry; preserve copy-then-delete pairing on the target side only.
- usage_rollup: services/analytics-service UsageRollupJob (Scala; EventLoader + UsageRollupAggregator; CronJob 0 2 * * *) — NDJSON events -> ow_tp.ow_tp_analytics.usage_rollup_daily; job ow_tp_analytics_usage_rollup. Preserve per-day aggregation incl. metadata[bytes] try->0 coercion; generatedAt is nondeterministic (excluded from parity).
Snapshot posture: materialize source extracts to ow_tp.ow_tp_analytics_src (fixture via AWS_ENDPOINT_URL); usage_rollup input is the deterministic seed (165 events over 3 days). Recon per tol-20261027-v1. Read .migration/units/<unit>/{dependencies.json,mapping_spec.json} and .migration/capabilities.json; evidence .migration/recon/wave-analytics-01/<batch>/.
